concerns.text: The implementation completely removes the transition to 'failed' for tasks with unmerged closed PRs. While this satisfies the JTBD to keep tasks active, consider logging warning-level messages instead of info-level if closed-unmerged PRs represent an irregular or stale development state.

verdicts.criticalReason: The PR performs a plain read-then-save update on the status/lifecycle field (specifically transitioning to terminal status 'done' in updateTaskStatus via taskRepository.save) instead of a guarded conditional update, while the Task entity is reachable from multiple independent call sites (the scheduled background sync job syncTaskStatusesWithGitHub and the direct endpoint updateTaskStatus). Additionally, the PR deletes nested gitignore files (data/.gitignore and target/.gitignore), which risks committing generated database files and maven build artifacts to the repository.

concerns.text: The deletion of data/.gitignore and target/.gitignore exposes the repository to committing persistent database files and Maven build artifacts.

The atomic status update looks excellent and robustly prevents concurrency issues. As a minor suggestion, findById is called again after the atomic update to return the updated entity; this is fine but does incur an extra database read.
